records.expected: Cosmological natural selection, or CNS, adds reproduction and selection to this picture. In this proposal, universes reproduce through black holes. Physical constants are numbers that describe how nature behaves. CNS says those constants mutate slightly between generations. Universes producing more black holes would leave more descendants. The constants should therefore sit near values that favor black-hole production.

These masses can be measured through pulsar timing.

records.expected: Test 2 decides the chain. PSR J1913+1102 has measured masses of 1.599 ± 0.008 and 1.290 ± 0.008 times the Sun's mass. Relative to the heavier star, they differ by 19.3 ± 0.7%.
